raw:
I remember my neighbor trying to unpack her groceries with one hand because her baby was asleep in her other arm. My attention went to the baby at first, and then I noticed how much she was trying to manage without disturbing that sleep. Something as ordinary as putting groceries away looked like quite a job with only one hand.

I felt for her. There were heavy jars to put away, so I helped with those. It wasn’t a big thing on my part, but I kept thinking how different the same little task can be when your arms are already full. She could keep holding her baby, and I could take care of that bit.
